description_en: Disassociates route tables from a VPC gateway endpoint
description_zh: 调用DissociateRouteTablesFromVpcGatewayEndpoint接口将网关终端节点与路由表解绑
name: DissociateRouteTablesFromVpcGatewayEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the gateway endpoint instance
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the route tables
parameters.name: route_table_ids

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate a value for this parameter on the client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:

true: sends a dry run request.
false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否检测此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the gateway endpoint belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
